Maya (CSM): Quick thread 99	final QBR prep for BeaconLabs tomorrow. Need: exec one-liner, onboarding status, renewal risk note. Can we lock by EOD?

Tom (Enablement): I999ll own onboarding slide. Current blocker: sample data schema mismatch. Proposing a mapping session + templates.

Ivy (Eng): We found the schema divergence. ETA for mapper is 36h. I999ll paste the small diff and a sample query to the slide notes.

Devon (CS Ops): For renewal risk heatmap: BeaconLabs = yellow (engagement dip). Add mitigation: enablement + 30d adoption pulse. Owner = Tom.

Rosa (Product): Exec one-liner draft: "Secure renewals by removing onboarding friction and proving embed metrics." Shorter?

Maya (CSM): Shorten to: "Remove onboarding friction to prove embed ROI." Approved.

Tom (Enablement): Workshop plan: 1x 60m mapping call, 1x 90m hands-on. Will draft slides and checklist. Owner: Tom, due next Tue.

Ivy (Eng): Perf note for deck: p95 latency ~430ms on dedicated; KV cache tuning cut tail by ~18%. I999ll add a line.

Devon (CS Ops): Canary note: if ingest lag >4h, route to backup and alert CSM. Adding runbook link.

qbr-bot: Reminder: use QBR action tracker - https://docs.internal/qbr-actions

Maya (CSM): Action rollup to paste into deck notes:
- Tom: Workshop slides + templates (due next Tue)
- Ivy: Mapper ETA + perf bullet (due EOD)
- Devon: Heatmap + runbook one-liner (due EOD)
- Rosa: Exec one-liner confirmed (done)

Tom (Enablement): I999ll schedule mapping call and add invites.

Maya (CSM): Can we do an exec dry run tomorrow 10:30am PT? Need Devon and Rosa to attend.

Devon (CS Ops): I999m available.

Rosa (Product): I999ll join.

Maya (CSM): Great. Post final deck link here after dry run and tag #beaconlabs for follow-ups. Thanks all :tada:
